description: Construction number 12. Named Pogrom. Stands about 100 m north of the Kfar Giladi museum as the memorial to Maj Naftali Porat of the Knights of the North squadron who was killed on 22 April 1969 when Vautour 03 was hit by anti-aircraft fire over Jordan. Confirmed by the spottingmode Israel review of 22 May 2026.
